title: Joe Biden: Oldest
credits: Caty Weaver wrote this story for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: VOA Learning English presents America's Presidents.
sentences.zh: 美国之音英语学习节目为您带来“美国总统”系列。

sentences.en: Today we are talking about Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 今天我们来聊聊乔·拜登。

sentences.en: He took office in 2021, becoming America’s 46th President.
sentences.zh: 他于2021年就职，成为美国第46任总统。

sentences.en: A member of the Democratic Party, Biden had been in national politics for a long time before he got to the White House.
sentences.zh: 作为民主党成员，拜登在进入白宫之前，早已在国家级政坛活跃了很长时间。

sentences.en: He served 36 years in the United States Senate representing Delaware.
sentences.zh: 他代表特拉华州担任美国参议员长达36年。

sentences.en: After that, he held two terms as the nation’s vice president, serving under President Barack Obama.
sentences.zh: 此后，他又担任了两届副总统，在巴拉克·奥巴马总统任下辅政。

sentences.en: Because Biden's presidency is so recent, this report will not discuss his time in office.
sentences.zh: 由于拜登的总统任期距今尚近，本报告不会涉及他的执政经历。

sentences.en: Instead, it will discuss his earlier life.
sentences.zh: 相反，本报告将聚焦他早年的生活。

sentences.en: Joseph Robinette Biden, Jr. was born in 1942 in Scranton, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 小约瑟夫·罗尼特·拜登于1942年出生于宾夕法尼亚州的斯克兰顿。

sentences.en: His family moved to Delaware when he was 10 years old.
sentences.zh: 10岁时，他的全家迁往特拉华州。

sentences.en: The Bidens were Roman Catholics of Irish ancestry.
sentences.zh: 拜登一家是爱尔兰裔的罗马天主教徒。

sentences.en: Joe was educated in private Roman Catholic schools as a youth.
sentences.zh: 乔年少时曾在私立的罗马天主教学校就读。

sentences.en: Later, he attended the University of Delaware.
sentences.zh: 后来，他进入特拉华大学求学。

sentences.en: He received a degree in political science and history in 1965.
sentences.zh: 1965年，他获得了政治学与历史学学位。

sentences.en: He also fell in love at Delaware with fellow student Neilia Hunter.
sentences.zh: 在特拉华大学期间，他还与同校学生内利亚·亨特坠入爱河。

sentences.en: The two married the following year.
sentences.zh: 两人于次年步入婚姻殿堂。

sentences.en: Over the next few years, the couple had three children.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，这对夫妇育有三个孩子。

sentences.en: Joe Biden also received his law degree from Syracuse University College of Law in New York.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登还在纽约的锡拉丘兹大学法学院获得了法学学位。

sentences.en: In 1972, at age 29, Joe Biden was elected to the U.S. Senate, representing Delaware.
sentences.zh: 1972年，29岁的乔·拜登当选为代表特拉华州的美国参议员。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, Biden faced tragedy.
sentences.zh: 几周后，拜登遭遇了悲剧。

sentences.en: Neilia and their children were in a car accident.
sentences.zh: 内利亚和他们的孩子遭遇了一起车祸。

sentences.en: She and daughter Naomi were killed in the crash.
sentences.zh: 她和女儿娜奥米在车祸中丧生。

sentences.en: Sons Beau and Hunter were injured.
sentences.zh: 儿子博和亨特受伤。

sentences.en: Biden was suddenly a single father.
sentences.zh: 拜登突然成了单亲父亲。

sentences.en: He briefly considered leaving his Senate seat.
sentences.zh: 他一度考虑辞去自己的参议员席位。

sentences.en: But he decided to stay in office.
sentences.zh: 但他决定留任。

sentences.en: Unlike most lawmakers, however, he did not move to Washington.
sentences.zh: 然而，与大多数立法者不同，他并没有搬到华盛顿去。

sentences.en: He did not want to uproot his little boys.
sentences.zh: 他不想让自己的两个小男孩随家搬迁、另谋安顿。

sentences.en: Instead, he traveled daily to and from Washington, D.C. on the train so he could be home with his sons every night.
sentences.zh: 相反，他每天乘坐火车往返于华盛顿特区，以便每晚都能陪伴儿子们。

sentences.en: The senator continued this custom for 36 years.
sentences.zh: 这位参议员延续了这一惯例，长达36年。

sentences.en: Also during that time, Biden met Jill Jacobs, an English teacher.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，拜登结识了英语教师吉尔·雅各布斯。

sentences.en: They fell in love and married in 1977.
sentences.zh: 两人相爱并于1977年结婚。

sentences.en: Daughter Ashley was born in 1981.
sentences.zh: 女儿阿什利出生于1981年。

sentences.en: Biden was a candidate for president in 1987 and 2007.
sentences.zh: 拜登在1987年和2007年曾竞选总统。

sentences.en: After Barack Obama was nominated as the Democratic Party’s 2008 presidential candidate, he asked Biden to join the campaign as his running mate.
sentences.zh: 在巴拉克·奥巴马被提名为民主党2008年总统候选人后，他邀请拜登作为竞选搭档加入竞选。

sentences.en: They won election and Biden began serving as vice president.
sentences.zh: 他们赢得选举，拜登开始担任副总统。

sentences.en: Four years later, Obama and Biden were re-elected for a second term.
sentences.zh: 四年后，奥巴马和拜登连任，进入第二个任期。

sentences.en: Most political experts say Biden was an especially powerful vice president.
sentences.zh: 大多数政治专家认为拜登是一位尤为有权势的副总统。

sentences.en: He and Obama worked closely together and Biden was influential in policy decisions.
sentences.zh: 他与奥巴马密切合作，在政策决策上颇具影响力。

sentences.en: The president sought Biden’s help in establishing a national economic stimulus program, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，总统曾寻求拜登的帮助，以建立一项国家经济刺激计划。

sentences.en: Biden also traveled the world as vice president and led diplomatic missions in troubled regions.
sentences.zh: 拜登在担任副总统期间也周游世界，并主导了动荡地区的外交使团。

sentences.en: He is widely considered one of the most successful vice presidents in American history.
sentences.zh: 他被视为美国历史上最成功的副总统之一。

sentences.en: During his second term as vice president, Joe Biden faced another family tragedy.
sentences.zh: 在担任副总统的第二任期内，乔·拜登遭遇了又一次家庭悲剧。

sentences.en: His adult son Beau died of brain cancer in 2015.
sentences.zh: 他的成年儿子博死于2015年的脑癌。

sentences.en: Joe Biden had considered running for president in 2016.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登曾考虑在2016年竞选总统。

sentences.en: But after Beau died, the Vice President decided against it.
sentences.zh: 但在博去世后，这位副总统放弃了这一想法。

sentences.en: The death of his son was too recent and the grief was too great to spend time on a campaign.
sentences.zh: 儿子的去世时间太近，悲痛太深，无法投入时间参与竞选。

sentences.en: Biden announced his candidacy for president in April of 2019.
sentences.zh: 拜登在2019年4月宣布竞选总统。

sentences.en: At 77, he was among the oldest presidential candidates ever.
sentences.zh: 77岁的他，是历来最年长的总统候选人之一。

sentences.en: His age became an issue of debate during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 他的年龄成为竞选期间的争议焦点。

sentences.en: But his main competitor, President Donald Trump, was just three years younger.
sentences.zh: 但他的主要竞争对手唐纳德·特朗普总统年仅比他小三岁。

sentences.en: Joe Biden called the presidential race “a battle for the soul of America.”
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登将这场总统大选称为“美国灵魂的较量”。

sentences.en: He won that battle when Americans went to voting stations on November 3, 2020.
sentences.zh: 在2020年11月3日美国人前往投票站投票时，他赢得了这场较量。

sentences.en: U.S. election officials announced later that week that Joe Biden and his vice presidential running mate, Kamala Harris, had defeated President Donald Trump and Vice President Mike Pence.
sentences.zh: 美国选举官员在同周晚些时候宣布，乔·拜登及其副总统搭档卡玛拉·哈里斯击败了唐纳德·特朗普总统和副总统迈克·彭斯。

sentences.en: Biden received 81 million votes in all --- more than any other American presidential candidate in history.
sentences.zh: 拜登共获得8100万张选票——超过历史上任何其他美国总统候选人。

sentences.en: Trump won about 74 million.
sentences.zh: 特朗普获得约7400万张。

sentences.en: However, Trump rejected the official vote count as incorrect and dishonest, calling the election “stolen.”
sentences.zh: 然而，特朗普否认官方计票结果，称其错误而不诚实，并称这次大选“被盗”。

sentences.en: Many of Trump’s supporters took the same position, causing severe division in the country.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的许多支持者持相同立场，导致国家严重分裂。

sentences.en: On January 20, 2021, Joe Biden was sworn in as President of the United States.
sentences.zh: 2021年1月20日，乔·拜登宣誓就任美国总统。

sentences.en: In a speech that followed, he called on the American people to seek unity with one another.
sentences.zh: 在随后的演讲中，他呼吁美国人民彼此寻求团结。

sentences.en: He described unity as one of the most “elusive” qualities in a democracy.
sentences.zh: 他把团结描述为民主制度中最“难以捉摸”的品质之一。

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver.
sentences.zh: 我是凯蒂·韦弗。

glossary.def: something that incites or stirs to action
glossary.zh: 刺激物；引发行动的事物
难以捉摸的；难以找到的
